adminLogin.title: Admin access
adminLogin.description: This protected portal is only for approved PROTOCOL36 administrators. Enter your registered admin email and we will send a one-time secure link.
adminLogin.checkEmailDescription: If {email} is an approved admin account, a one-time access link has been sent. Open it in this browser within one hour.
adminLogin.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
adminLogin.errorInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

errors.provider: The email provider rejected or cancelled this sign-in attempt.
errors.missingToken: This access link is incomplete. Request a new link below.
errors.expired: This access link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new link below.
errors.session: The secure session could not be created. Request a new link and try again.
errors.notAdmin: This email is not an approved PROTOCOL36 administrator. An existing administrator must approve it before login.
errors.rateLimit: The authentication email limit has been reached. Please wait before requesting another link, or ask the project owner to configure production SMTP.

citizenLogin.title: Citizen sign in
citizenLogin.description: Sign in to submit private victim evidence and track your review status. A one-time secure link will be sent to your email.
citizenLogin.checkEmailDescription: A one-time sign-in link has been sent to {email}. Open it in this browser within one hour.
citizenLogin.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
citizenLogin.errorInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

errors.provider: The email provider rejected or cancelled this sign-in attempt.
errors.missingToken: This sign-in link is incomplete. Request a new link below.
errors.expired: This sign-in link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new link below.
errors.session: The secure session could not be created. Request a new link and try again.
errors.notAdmin: This account cannot access the administrator portal.
errors.rateLimit: The authentication email limit has been reached. Please wait before requesting another link, or ask the project owner to configure production SMTP.

citizenPortal.title: Your evidence submissions
citizenPortal.description: Evidence and contact details are visible only to you and authorized PROTOCOL36 administrators.
citizenPortal.empty: You have not submitted any evidence yet.
